newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Centennial 9-mth net at 21.31 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Centennial 9-mth net at 21.31 mln pesos.

text.p: Land developer Centennial City Inc posted a net income of 21.31 million pesos in the first nine months to March 31, 1997.
Revenues reached 61.56 million pesos during the nine-month period.
The company did not give any comparative figures. Centennial operates on a fiscal year basis ending June.
The six-month net income to December 31, 1996 amounted to 17.85 million pesos, while revenues were at 43.69 million pesos.
Centennial has a 20 percent stake in the Thai-Philippine consortium which has a 750-hectare reclamation project in Manila Bay.
